sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:132005
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 26623 of 2024

Applicant :- Lakhan Singh Pathror
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Prabhakar Dwivedi,Vikram Bahadur Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Manoj Kumar Srivastava
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Vikram Bahadur Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant; Sri Manoj Kumar Srivastava,
learned counsel for the informant and Sri Rajiv Dhar Dwivedi, learned Aga for the
State-respondent.
3.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
70 of 2024, under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 506 Ipc, Police Station Sahibabad, District
Ghaziabad, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4.  Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that on the basis of false allegations only due to the reason that after murder of the husband of the co-accused Monika Sharma, applicant performed marriage with her, he has been made accused in the present matter.

sentences.text:
He further submitted that after considering entire facts of the case co-accused Monika Sharma,
daughter in law of the informant has been released on bail vide order dated 12.8.2024 passed in Crl.
Misc. Bail Application No. 26657 of 2024 and on merit, case of applicant is on better footing than co-accused Monika Sharma.
6.

entities.text:
Crl.
Misc. Bail Application No. 26657 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He further submitted that earlier also applicant was made accused in one criminal case but after investigation, in that case final report has been submitted and all the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate Ist class and applicant is in jail in the present matter since 3.7.2024.
7. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the arguments on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. However, as per allegation, applicant alongwith co-accused Monika Sharma, daughter in law of the informant duped the informant and misappropriated the amount of late Ajay Panchal, husband of co-accused Monika Sharma but it reflects that the allegation of misappropriation of money was mainly against the co-accused Monika Sharma and after considering entire facts of the case, she has already been released on bail on merit and after considering entire material available on record, this Court finds force in the argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant that as far as merit of the case is concerned, case of applicant is on far better footing than the case of co-accused Monika.
10.
Further, however, earlier also applicant was made accused in one another criminal case but in that case also final report has been submitted.
11. Further, all the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate Ist class and applicant is in jail in the present matter since 3.7.2024.

12. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
13. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

14. Let the applicant-Lakhan Singh Pathror, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from Lakhan Singh Pathror vs State Of U.P. on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109656341/
2 disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
15.

sentences.text: In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

16. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
